messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH latency SLO burn detected for runtime-gateway-uswest — p95=420ms, p99=1200ms, alert_id=PD-9921
jamal: @incident-bot acked. i'm on it. starting quick triage. :rotating_light:
maria: seeing elevated tail in the dashboard too — https://dash.redwood/runtime-gateway/us-west?range=5m
alex: confirmed, request queue up and KV cache miss spike at ~03:12 UTC. looks like a hotkey pattern hitting sidecar nodes.
jamal: running quick curl against a stable endpoint to measure latency locally:
```
> curl -s -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://runtime-usw.redwood/v1/llm/health
0.48
```
jamal: local probe 480ms on health — matches p95.
ops-runner-bot: autoscaler: current_replicas=6 desired=12 (scaleup initiated)
maria: can we temporarily increase sidecar pool and enable striped routing to avoid hot nodes?
jamal: doing manual scale and a rolling restart on suspect sidecars. cmds:
```
kubectl -n prod-uswest scale deployment runtime-sidecar --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod-uswest rollout restart deployment runtime-sidecar
```
alex: also toggling KV cache prewarm + prefix caching for the high-volume namespace. patch applied.
ops-runner-bot: cache-warm job started: namespace=prod-uswest:kv-highvolume, job_id=warm-3344
sophie: heads up i'm taking next on-call window in 20m, want a short handoff when things stabilize.
jamal: current mitigation steps: scaled sidecars to 12, restarted suspect pods, kicked off kv-warm job, temporarily increased per-route concurrency cap (route: /v1/llm/generate)
jamal: running live logs, will tail 3 pods for 10m to watch for error spikes.
alex: i see reduced tails in the last 2 minutes, p95 dropped to ~210ms. p99 still jittery around 600-800ms.
maria: customer impact check — put together quick list from alerts:~12 customers affected, 4 with elevated error rates, top affected product is chat-ux (paying). notifying CS & account teams.
jamal: @pagerduty escalate policy: if p99 > 1000ms for another 5m, escalate to SE oncall. currently 2m left on the timer.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgment recorded by jamal at 3344556680
ops-runner-bot: mitigation-check: sidecar cpu 70% -> 45% after scale, queue depth 240 -> 60.
sophie: thanks, jamal. when you hand off please include the runbook link and what we should watch.
jamal: handoff note:
- root: hotspot on a small subset of sidecar hosts caused KV cache misses and long tail latency.
- done: scaled sidecar pool 6->12, restarted suspect pods, launched kv prewarm job, increased route concurrency cap.
- watch: p99, queue depth, rate of kv-miss (metric: runtime.kv.miss_rate), number of hotkey requests (runtime.hotkey.count).
- runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/latency-kv-hotkey
- next steps: if p99 remains >800ms after 10m, progressively route traffic to eu fallback region and enable degraded model mode for heavy routes.
jamal: handing to @sophie in 10m. i'll stay reachable for immediate questions. :thumbsup:
sophie: grabbing handoff. i'll monitor for the rotation and be ready to trigger cross-region failover. ping me in thread if p99 > 800ms.
maria: i've alerted CS and added a brief customer message draft to #customer-notify.
ops-runner-bot: alert summary: peak p99=1250ms, peak queue depth=520, affected_replicas=3/6 pre-scale. current p95=200ms p99=610ms.
sophie: ack handoff at 3344556725 — taking over monitoring. jamal, please DM if you escalate.
jamal: thanks — leaving detailed logs clipped to the incident doc. will check back in 15m.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for on-call handoff (owner=sophie) — follow-up tasks created: TASK-7782 (kv cache tuning), TASK-7783 (hotkey throttling).
